listings.description: Completes the main scenario through 'Before the Dawn' (end of A Realm Reborn). Does not raise level.

contents.name: Tales of Adventure: A Realm Reborn

listings.notes: Next: 'Coming to Ishgard' needs a level 50 DoW/DoM. Includes 10 Silver Chocobo Feathers and 30 Allagan Platinum Pieces (300,000 gil to vendors). Store ID 993.

listings.name: Tales of Adventure: Heavensward
listings.description: Completes the main scenario through 'The Far Edge of Fate' (end of Heavensward), including the A Realm Reborn item. Does not raise level.
listings.notes: Next: 'Beyond the Great Wall' needs a level 60 DoW/DoM. Includes 10 Silver Chocobo Feathers and 30 Allagan Platinum Pieces (300,000 gil). Store ID 994.

listings.name: Tales of Adventure: Stormblood
listings.description: Completes the main scenario through 'A Requiem for Heroes' (end of Stormblood), including the earlier items. Does not raise level.
listings.notes: Next: 'The Syrcus Trench' needs a level 70 DoW/DoM and Shadowbringers. Includes 10 Silver Chocobo Feathers and 50 Allagan Platinum Pieces (500,000 gil). Store ID 995.

listings.name: Tales of Adventure: Shadowbringers
listings.description: Completes the main scenario through 'Death Unto Dawn' (end of Shadowbringers). Does not raise level.
listings.notes: Next: Endwalker needs a level 80 DoW/DoM. Includes 10 Silver Chocobo Feathers and 50 Allagan Platinum Pieces (500,000 gil). Not usable on limited jobs. Store ID 996.

listings.name: Tales of Adventure: Endwalker
listings.description: Completes the main scenario through 'The Coming Dawn' (end of Endwalker) and role quests through Shadowbringers, ready to start Dawntrail. Does not raise level.
listings.notes: Dawntrail's first quest 'A New World to Explore' (Ojika Tsunjika, Old Sharlayan) needs a level 90 DoW/DoM and Dawntrail. Includes 10 Silver Chocobo Feathers and 50 Allagan Platinum Pieces (500,000 gil). Store ID 997.
